title: 254 Yacht Pond Lane | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gorgeous 7 Bedroom 7 Bath Large Home with Carriage House in WaterSound!
description_expanded: Description: 254 Yacht Pond by Royal Destinations Location: WaterSound Proper Address: 254 Yacht Pond Lane by Royal Destinations Details: Bringing a touch of sophisticated Cape Cod charm to the stunning shores of the Emerald Coast, 254 Yacht Pond is ideally located on a spacious corner in the upscale 30A neighborhood of Watersound. Featuring seven serene bedrooms, a charming carriage house, and various inviting living areas, this property ensures that families and friends can stay connected while still enjoying ample space to unwind. Guests of WaterSound have access to a variety of community amenities, including a vast beachfront, private beach access, winding boardwalks, the Dunsider Pool with seasonal poolside dining, Puttering Park, and much more. WaterSound Community Highlights: -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) -Kayak Rentals -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) *Please Note: Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 7 bedrooms and 6 1/2 baths First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bathroom (Vessel Tub and Separate Shower) - Bedroom 2: Two Twin Beds - Living Room, Dining Room, Gourmet Kitchen, Wet Bar - Half Bath - Laundry Room Second Floor: - Bedroom 3: King Bedroom with Private Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 4: King Bedroom with Private Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 5: Two Twin Beds with Private Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 6: Two Twin Beds with Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) Third Floor Viewing Tower: - Views of WaterSound and Limited Gulf Views Carriage House: -Bedroom 7: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) - Living Area, Full Kitchen, Balcony with Seating Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
